prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Existing account pet sync warning: Display a explicit notice on the sign-in screen advising users to sign in with their original account to preserve existing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Already have a pet? Sign in with your original account to restore your existing pet."}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive pet personality selector redesign: Redesign the friend picker screen with a split layout and interactive choice cards to select pet personality and play style.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Select Your Pet's Companion Personality", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Playful vs Calm Temperament", "style": "playful"}]}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop pet roaming mode selector screen: Insert a new screen before home intro allowing users to choose whether their pet roams screen-wide or stays anchored to the taskbar.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_roaming_setup", "home_intro"], "new_roaming_setup": {"headline": "Desktop Roaming Preferences", "body": "Choose how your pet moves across your windows.", "layout": "centered"}}
3: [choose_path, layout] Split screen path comparison layout: Switch the path selection layout to a split layout comparing standard premade pets directly alongside custom pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Starting Path"}}
4: [home, wait_info] Pet generation progress and status tips: Show an active progress status indicator and detailed generation phase tips while waiting for pet creation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 12, "hint": "Generating 3D assets and animations for your desktop companion..."}}
5: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign in after pet waiting step: Move the sign-in step to occur right after pet generation completes, directly before the home intro screen.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"]}
6: [adoption, new_flow] Pet photo customization studio flow: Introduce a dedicated photo refinement step between photo upload and adoption certificate to adjust lighting and pet color palette.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_studio", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_photo_studio": {"headline": "Fine-tune Pet Appearance", "body": "Adjust color tones and lighting before generating your custom pet.", "layout": "centered"}}
7: [finish, incentive] Starter pet toy item reward incentive: Add a highlighted welcome bonus banner on the home intro screen granting free starter toys upon finishing setup.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Free Starter Toy Pack Unlocked!", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [choose_path, copy] Instant path switch reassurance copy: Update the choose path headline and subtext to reassure users they can change pet paths anytime without losing progress.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select your path - switch options anytime", "hint": "You can always switch between premade and custom pets later in settings."}}
9: [home, notification] Desktop launch notification alert on ready: Enable desktop notification options on the waiting screen to alert users when pet generation is finished if the app is minimized.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Feel free to minimize. We will notify your desktop when your pet is ready!"}}

Redesigns the friend picker while retaining its core function of choosing a pet.
Adds a valid new preference setup screen inside onboarding prior to home intro.
Redesigns path selection layout while preserving options for both premade and custom pets.
Enhances the waiting screen with progress indicators without breaking any base rules.
Reorders sign-in step to after waiting screen, which is explicitly allowed.
Adds a photo refinement screen inside the onboarding flow without removing required steps.
Onboarding copy explicitly mentions free extras ('Free Starter Toy Pack Unlocked!').
Updates choose path copy with reassurance without breaking any rules.
Adds desktop notification settings to the waiting screen within allowed scope.
